opis: PANEL 1 (the big one on the left), early morning, soft pink dawn light in an autumn forest: the FOX, alone, happily gathers RED things into his arms - a shiny red apple, a big red maple leaf, a red toy block and a red-and-white ball - each tied with a golden ribbon bow. PANEL 2 (top right), dawn in the autumn orchard from the reference picture: the FOX tiptoes under the apple tree and carefully lays the red gifts with golden bows on the grass, looking over his shoulder. PANEL 3 (bottom right), morning: the FOX peeks out shyly from behind a thick tree trunk, only his head and one paw seen, blushing and smiling, watching the little pile of red gifts under the apple tree. Gentle, warm and a little funny; the fox is the ONLY animal in the picture.
